name: Chainalysis free sanctions screening API
tier_rationale: Established blockchain-analytics company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P205 cond 7 'Registry tiers: Chainalysis ... trusted'.

reliability.justification: Chainalysis-curated list of addresses named in sanctions designations (OFAC and others); a match is a list match, not a legal determination (P205 cond 6).

error_markers.reason: Chainalysis REST: the egress IP is not on the Allowed IPs List of the key (allow-list the team egress; could not verify)

chainalysis.description: Chainalysis free sanctions-screening API key (X-API-Key header); the key also needs the team egress IP on its Allowed IPs List
chainalysis.plan_hint: a company account; record the plan in key_plans (key-terms, P205 cond 7) before corporate use

sanctions_api.title: Chainalysis REST public.chainalysis.com/api/v1/address/{address} (sanctions identifications, all chains)

terms.quote: Terms: OFAC lists 'open'; oracle and stablecoin calls 'open' (public contracts, RPC provider ToS recorded); TronGrid and Chainalysis REST 'key-terms' (company accounts, plans recorded). Registry tiers: Chainalysis, PublicNode (Allnodes) and TronGrid (TRON DAO) trusted.

sanctions_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P205 cond 7). Research C0490 (verified_needs_key: 403 text/html 'Your IP address is not on the Chainalysis Allowed IPs List' without a key). Second check next to the on-chain oracle, covering non-EVM chains (P205 cond 4); 403 'Allowed IPs List' with a key = BLOCKED (marker chainalysis_ip_allowlist), no key = NEEDS_KEY.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G09-1 (P205 crypto_sanctions_onchain). The keyless on-chain oracle (same upstream family 'chainalysis') runs through the PublicNode RPC (provider publicnode, source ethereum_rpc).
